summary: Deterministic validator for the host-agnostic agent contract

delivery.outcome: governance-check.sh proves deterministically that the fail-closed hook is installed and active and that packaging metadata runs the gate, instead of trusting that a model read an instruction file.
nonGoals: Distributing host files to adopters; that is the dependent distribution slice.
Adding a CI job or changing any GitHub ruleset.
Changing any adopter repository from this hub.

architecture.decision: Declare the host and packaging contract once in governance/agent-hosts.json, validate it in a standalone CLI that governance_check.py imports the same way it imports decision_record, and register every emitted code so the diagnostics audit can no longer miss the hook.
interfaceChanges: governance/agent-hosts.json is a new managed governance artifact
scripts/agent_host_check.py is a new deterministic validator CLI
GOV-AGENT-HOST-004..006 and GOV-PACKAGING-001..003 are registered diagnostics
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch. No adopter is touched and no managed digest changes.

validation.evidence: GOV-AGENT-HOST-PASS with zero findings in an activated clone.
Negative fixtures fail closed: missing host file, non-executable hook, unset core.hooksPath, undeclared and drifted packaging metadata.
Every registered code is emitted and every linked runbook is distributed to adopters.
